description: This Java class handles MQTT 5 subscriptions within a messaging service, specifically for HiveMQ MQTT client. It extends a generic abstract handler to manage subscription creation and mapping from sources and addresses, integrating with Eclipse Ditto's connectivity models.

classes.name: HiveMqtt5SubscriptionHandler
classes.description: Final class that manages MQTT 5 subscription handling by extending an abstract MQTT subscription handler, utilizing HiveMQ's MQTT client library.

methods.name: HiveMqtt5SubscriptionHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the subscription handler with connection details, MQTT client, and logger.

methods.name: toMqttSubscribe
methods.description: Converts a given source into an MQTT 5 subscription request by mapping source addresses to QoS and topic filters.
